leave_bereavement_days_007.answer: 3 paid days within a two-week period, plus up to 2 additional days (PTO or unpaid)
leave_bereavement_days_007.evidence: The employee shall be granted bereavement leave of absence with pay and without loss of Paid Time Off (PTO) benefits for up to a maximum of three (3) regularly scheduled days within a two (2) week period... The employee shall be allowed to use an additional two (2) days PTO or vacation allowance or, if the employee has no remaining PTO or vacation allowance, the employee may take an unpaid leave of absence for such two (2) additional days;

leave_bereavement_relatives_008.answer: Immediate family members (son, daughter, spouse, parent, grandparent, sister, brother, grandchild, or by marriage) and close non-family members (case-by-case analysis)
leave_bereavement_relatives_008.evidence: 'Immediate family member' is defined as a son, daughter, spouse, parent, grandparent, sister, brother, grandchild or anyone of the same relationship by marriage. A 'close non-family member' is defined on a case-by-case analysis of a legally undefined relationship between the employee and the decedent.
